name: Donde Onde Where
description:
Donde Onde Where (DOW) is an editorial index of independent restaurants and bars, currently covering the UK, Portugal and Spain. This connector puts that index directly into your assistant, so recommendations come from venues that are actually tracked and profiled, each with a link to its full page.

Ask about a city and you get its neighbourhoods, with venue counts and how active each one is. Ask about a neighbourhood and you get its Hot Score ranking. Hot Score is DOW's own momentum measure: it reacts to recent review activity, rating baseline and how complete a venue's profile is, and it is a leading indicator of who is gaining attention now, not a ranking of who is already famous. Ask about a venue by name and you get DOW's editorial verdict: what to book it for, its signature dishes, what it suits, its rating and review count.

Two further tools cover what is new and what is being noticed. One returns the venues that most recently crossed DOW's editorial threshold in a city. The other reports whether a named venue appears in DOW's own AI-citation probes across several assistants, and states the sample size, so an absence reads as "not in our probes" rather than "invisible".

The index is maintained rather than scraped once: venue data is refreshed on a rolling cycle and new venues are added as they qualify. Chains, cafes and bakeries are excluded on purpose. DOW publishes in English alongside further language editions aimed at the largest visitor populations to the regions it covers.

Coverage is specific cities and neighbourhoods, not whole countries, and it grows. The connector reports the current list on request.

Everything is read-only and free. There is no account, no sign-in and no approval step, and the connector holds no identity for you. It returns public venue information only, with no personal data and no individual reviewer content.

Donde Onde Where is operated by booteek AI Limited.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Donde Onde Where to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Donde Onde Where to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://booteek.ai/api/mcp/dow/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Donde Onde Where MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Donde Onde Where scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Donde Onde Where MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Donde Onde Where provides these MCP tools: dow_ai_citation_status, dow_hot_list, dow_recently_added, dow_venue_lookup, dow_zone_health, and dow_zones.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Donde Onde Where?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Donde Onde Where in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Donde Onde Where MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Donde Onde Where does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Donde Onde Where is developed by booteek AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
